facts.fact: Data centres dataset: LTC Mobile National Data Centre (Liberia Telecommunications Corporation (LTC Mobile)), colocation/carrier-neutral, in service; this document names it (published 2026-03-01).

Liberia's National Data Governance Policy says the National Data Center, spearheaded by the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications for government and private sector use, is located at the state-owned national operator LTC-Mobile and is being upgraded under the World Bank GREAT Project; it does not itself say who owns the centre, only that it sits at a state-owned operator. Dated by the document's published date (March 2026), as it gives no other date.

The policy states that GovNet, which connects more than 107 ministries, agencies and commissions, suffers from the absence of a centralised data centre, and that a national data centre still needs to be established or designated to host critical government datasets. Dated by the document's published date (March 2026), as it gives no other date.
